# Wahid · The ʿAḍud — www.adhud.xyz

> Mutual solidarity network. Open your account with a **$1 USD membership** (card checkout). English-first, global audience. Trust and interconnection — not fundraising.

## Live site
- https://www.adhud.xyz
- https://www.adhud.xyz/network — member map

## Join (primary)
1. Pick a unique username
2. Pay **$1 USD** via card checkout (Suby)
3. Get your member desk at `/member/{username}`

## Join (legacy)
- **5 USDT** on TRC-20 to House wallet (collapsible on site)

## Brand voice
- Brotherhood, family mutual solidarity, trust first
- Never scam or money-collection framing
- "Do not join to take. Join because you are someone's arm."

## Social
- X: @adudadid (English-first)
- Share copy built into the site (WhatsApp + X intent links)
